identity.title: Our identity
identity.text: The Work and Mutuality Association (ATM) is a Malagasy association committed to promoting mutual aid, solidarity and community development.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: Chaired by Mr. TSIAVELA Etienne, ATM works mainly for vulnerable children and families, women in vulnerable situations and elderly people without support.

actions.title: Our actions
actions.text: The association carries out various social actions: distribution of school supplies, food assistance, support for the elderly and initiatives for community well-being.

partnership.title: Let's build together
partnership.text: ATM continues its development by seeking serious, transparent and sustainable partnerships to strengthen its actions for the benefit of vulnerable communities.
